title: Anonymized BERT: An Augmentation Approach to the Gendered Pronoun Resolution Challenge

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the log loss ratio between masculine and feminine ambiguous pronoun resolution performance using the GAP (Gendered Ambiguous Pronouns) dataset.

Evaluating overall model improvements when substituting idiosyncratic and foreign (non-Western) names with common English placeholder names to remove region-specific biases from contextual embeddings.
